records.title: Categorizing the Content of GitHub README Files
records.authors: Gede Artha Azriadi Prana, Christoph Treude, Ferdian Thung, Thushari Atapattu, David Lo
records.verified_scope: Paper sampling, Table 2 codebook and adjudication; repository README, CSV header and raw rows; MIT license text
records.baseline_status: known baseline; newly inspected label table, selection and data header
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: Original coding reference: What, Why, How, When, Who, References, Contribution, Other; classifier combines Why and What and adds Exclusion. CSV fields section-id, file-id, url, heading, Codes with >= 2 votes.
records.size_and_count_basis: 4,226 sections of 393 English software README files; 1,193 repositories screened; README under 2KB and nonsoftware excluded; raw CSV also includes excluded rows marked -
records.reliability: Two initial raters kappa 0.858, third rater/adjudication; use original context of reported kappa
records.annotation_license: Unknown whether repository license covers annotations
records.source_text_rights: Individual project text rights require separate verification
records.access_status: public; source text in repository but independently verify individual versions
records.reuse_recommendation: Seed provisional README-specific section role vocabulary and sampling strata; retain multilabel and disagreements, avoid mechanical mandatory sections
records.project_feature_mapping: F02,F08,F09; F03 only after verifying archived full README and section parser
records.limitations: Exclusion criteria and era prevent population norms; sample is not curated high-quality; majority votes are not spans; headings can contain multiple functions.

records.title: An Annotated Corpus for Machine Reading of Instructions in Wet Lab Protocols
records.authors: Chaitanya Kulkarni, Wei Xu, Alan Ritter, Raghu Machiraju
records.verified_scope: Full paper tables and appendix guideline; inspected matching .ann and .txt; license
records.unit: action/entity character spans and within-sentence links; title plus linewise step text
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: Action, Reagent and example event relations Acts-on, Using, Site; 17 entity types, 12 directed links per paper; additional NUMERICAL, GENERIC-MEASURE, SIZE, PH, MEASURE-TYPE, MENTION, MODIFIER, SEAL. Examples are partial inventory, see appendix for complete definitions.
records.size_and_count_basis: 622 protocols; paper reports 13,679 sentences and 177,770 words
records.reliability: Four coders in iterative 10-protocol exercises; alpha 0.7599 entities/actions, 0.6625 relations
records.annotation_license: License file MIT but independent applicability to annotations unclear
records.source_text_rights: protocols.io originating text rights not established by repository license
records.reuse_recommendation: Borrow offsets, event-role linking and boundary guidance for task-step experiments
records.project_feature_mapping: F08,F09; exploratory F05 only for this extracted domain
records.limitations: Steps are text extracts, not confirmed full source documents; laboratory task bias; actions are not rhetorical paragraph functions.
